page.title: Models
page.purpose: Make the model registry legible: what is installed, what it costs in disk and VRAM, what licence it carries, and whether it may be used in commercially distributed output.

priorities.statement: Licence and commercial-use lane are visible on every model without opening a detail view — they are decision-critical, not metadata.
An install that would exhaust disk is refused with the shortfall named before any bytes are written.

states.description: Host cannot meet the model's hardware gates.
Installing would breach the free-disk floor.
Non-commercial or unknown licence; excluded from commercial builds.

claims.statement: Every model row displays its commercial-use lane.
Disk and VRAM cost are shown before the install action is taken.
A model blocked by hardware gates or the disk floor surfaces the reason rather than an enabled install control.
